convention.bins: make_bins(reference + 800k target), shared by both statistics
convention.measured: pooled sqrt(sum pulls^2 / (total bins - 1)), full runs, r2_ladder.pulls
convention.prediction: E[pull^2](N) = 1 + eps2 qa^2 / [qhatN^2(1-qhatN)(1/na + 1/(N qb))], qhatN = (Na qa + N qb)/(Na+N); width = sqrt(mean over kept bins)
convention.naive: same with the reference term 1/na dropped from v(N)
convention.status: measured exact vs archived file; predicted within +-0.001; paper naive 2.4 not reproduced (this convention gives 2.20/2.23)
